description: This source file implements Unix socket-based inter-process communication (IPC) with support for server-client connection management, threading, and socket handling. It includes functions for establishing, managing, and shutting down IPC server and client connections, with thread pools and socket queue management.

classes.name: ipc_server_reply_data
classes.description: Holds reply data including file descriptor and associated worker thread data.

classes.name: ipc_worker_thread_data
classes.description: Represents a worker thread in the IPC server thread pool, linked in a list.

classes.name: ipc_accept_thread_data
classes.description: Contains data for the accept thread, including server socket and shutdown file descriptors.

classes.name: ipc_server_data
classes.description: Main structure managing the IPC server, including thread pool, socket queue, and synchronization primitives.

methods.name: ipc_get_active_state
methods.description: Determines the active state of the IPC socket at a given path.

methods.name: connect_to_server
methods.description: Attempts to connect to the IPC server within a timeout, with retries.

methods.name: ipc_client_try_connect
methods.description: Tries to establish a client connection to the IPC server.

methods.name: ipc_client_close_connection
methods.description: Closes and frees an IPC client connection.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command_to_connection
methods.description: Sends a command over an IPC connection and reads the response.

methods.name: ipc_client_send_command
methods.description: Establishes a connection, sends a command, and closes the connection.

methods.name: ipc_server_init_async
methods.description: Initializes and starts an asynchronous IPC server with thread pool.

methods.name: ipc_server_stop_async
methods.description: Signals the IPC server to shutdown gracefully.

methods.name: ipc_server_await
methods.description: Waits for all server threads to finish.

methods.name: ipc_server_free
methods.description: Frees all resources associated with the IPC server.
